methods_and_source_files: Own undissolved ACS2024 TIGER polygon covers existing point
Existing year is 2020 or later; outside replacement trigger
Entire own ACS2024 place polygon covered by exactly one ACS2024 county polygon; no centroid or majority-county inference
ALAND-scaled distance: d <= sqrt(ALAND/pi); extent screening, not polygon containment
